## Corrections and questions

The project will use a project email address as the correction and contact channel. Users may report:

- suspected errors;
- missing publications;
- sequence discrepancies;
- metadata corrections; and
- reuse and licensing questions.

[{{< var project-email >}}](mailto:{{< var project-email >}})
